sentences.en: The millionaire intended to purchase the masterpiece regardless of cost.
sentences.zh: 这位百万富翁打算不惜一切代价购买这幅杰作。

sentences.en: The millionaire lived in complete isolation from the outside world.
sentences.zh: 这位百万富翁与外界完全隔绝地生活。

sentences.en: Nobody envied the old man, who was a millionaire.
sentences.zh: 没有人羡慕那位百万富翁老人。
